scenes.heading: Growing through referrals and repeat clients

sents.d: Growing through referrals and repeat clients
Existing clients are usually your lowest-cost source of new business.
A referral from a past client typically converts better and costs less to acquire than a cold lead from advertising, yet many photographers never systematically ask for referrals.

scenes.heading: Follow up a few weeks later

sents.d: Following up a few weeks after delivery — not just immediately after the shoot — to check satisfaction and ask if they know anyone else who might need photography catches people at a natural, low-pressure moment.

A modest referral incentive (a print credit or small discount on a future session) formalizes the ask and gives happy clients a concrete reason to mention you by name instead of just a general recommendation.

take: Ask happy clients for referrals a few weeks after delivery.
